title: M1 — Semantic records, publication, and retrieval
description: Publish versioned semantic records idempotently with recovery, retire stale regions, and expose typed searchAudio through exact local and native DynamoDB vector adapters. Dedicated on-demand 512 DOT_PRODUCT index. Canonical visibility/revision verification before returning hits; default24/max100; no catalog scans or arbitrary pagination. Depends M0.
